Tenant Protection Act of 1992 eligibility (Hudson County only)
coverage.summary: Applies to buildings being converted to condominium, cooperative or fee-simple ownership. Protected tenancy covers eligible senior, disabled or veteran tenants; the conversion-cost rent bar covers all tenants. The Tenant Protection Act of 1992 extension applies only in Hudson County.
coverage.other_conditions: Triggered only by conversion. Protected tenants must have lived in the building at least one year before the conversion recording date.

result.notes: Coverage is confirmed as stated against D067. requires_unknown_facts stays true because the rule applies only to buildings undergoing condominium, cooperative or fee-simple conversion, which assessor data cannot identify. No unit-count, construction-date or owner limits are stated for this act. The 'two or more dwelling units' language in D067 belongs to the Anti-Eviction Act conversion ground (N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.1(k)), not to this act, so min_units stays null. The quoted span 'd ate' reproduces the source's spacing typo. D065, D066, D068, D069 and DX16 do not address this rule.
